connector.name: MCP Pear
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Pear Protocol: markets, positions, orders, portfolio, and gated trade execution.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-pear. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the marvelnwachukwu account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PEAR_API_KEY
env.description: Pear API key for authenticated read/write tools (single-user mode). Public tools work without it.

env.name: PEAR_ADDRESS
env.description: Wallet address (0x...) bound to PEAR_API_KEY. Required alongside PEAR_API_KEY.

env.name: PEAR_JWT
env.description: Pre-minted Pear JWT for multi-tenant orchestrators (JWT pass-through mode). Used directly when set.

env.name: PEAR_REFRESH_TOKEN
env.description: Refresh token so the server refreshes an expired JWT itself instead of requiring a restart.

env.name: PEAR_TRADE_ENABLED
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable the write/trade-execution tools. Off by default.
